newsitem.title: FRANCE: ITT may have sold Alcatel shares - traders.
newsitem.headline: ITT may have sold Alcatel shares - traders.

text.p: U.S. group ITT is rumoured to have sold the rest of its shares in Alcatel Alsthom, traders said on Friday. They said the price, according to market talk, was 567 francs per share.
ITT holds 2.8 percent of Alcatel, or 4.5 million shares, after having sold 2.2 percent on February 13.

Officials at Alcatel were not immediately available for comment. The French group has given ITT the nod to sell its stake before July 3 -- the earliest date possible under a previous shareholder agreement. ITT is trying to fend off a hostile takeover by Hilton Hotels.
Alcatel shares were down 0.17 percent at 586 francs at 1315 GMT.
